rule: Remove ceil(25% of each original phase) ranked by abs(log observed/predicted), tie break row_id, union all OutlierTree 0.099 full-cohort flags. Training residuals from 3-fold OOF CatBoost. Validation/test residuals from saved train-fit CatBoost assessment. No original row is overwritten.
